Done. Rooms now have a topic.

**Storage** — `db/changes/20260823101500_add_topic_to_rooms.rb` adds a nullable `topic` string column; `db/schema.rb` regenerated by running the migration.

**Validation** — `platform/core/entities/room.rb:3` defines `TOPIC_MAXIMUM_LENGTH = 120`, and `validates :topic, length: { maximum: TOPIC_MAXIMUM_LENGTH }`. `nil` and `""` pass, so a room without a topic stays valid.

**Editing** — `room_params` in `delivery/http/handlers/rooms_controller.rb:57` now permits `:topic`, so the existing `Rooms::OpensController#update` / `Rooms::ClosedsController#update` (and `#create`) save it. The field lives in `delivery/http/render/rooms/layouts/_form.html.erb`, the same form as the name, inside the same `Current.user.can_administer?(room)` branch that gates renaming — so exactly the people who can rename can set the topic, on the same screen, in the same PUT. That form is shared by the open and closed room new/edit screens; direct rooms have no update action and can't be renamed either, so they're unchanged.

**Display** — the topic shows beside the room name in the room header (`rooms/show/_nav.html.erb` plus a `.room__topic` rule in `nav.css` that hides it on narrow screens), and non-administrators see it as read-only text on the settings screen. I also added a `room_topic` entry to `TranslationsHelper::TRANSLATIONS` so the field gets the same globe button as every other labelled input.

**Rejection behavior worth flagging:** the form carries `maxlength="120"`, so the UI can't submit an over-long topic. The controllers use `update!`/`create!` (the existing idiom here), so a hand-crafted request past that limit raises `ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid` → Rails' default 422. It's rejected, never saved, but the user gets a bare error page rather than the form re-rendered with a message. Rendering `:edit` with an inline error would be nicer; I left it alone because no controller in this app does that yet and it would mean introducing error display into the shared form. Say the word if you want it.

Tests: 348 existing tests still pass; I added 8 (`test/suite/persistence/room_test.rb`, `test/suite/endpoints/rooms/opens_controller_test.rb`, `closeds_controller_test.rb`) covering optional/boundary/over-limit topics, setting a topic in the same request as a rename, and a non-administrator being refused. 356 runs, 0 failures, same 2 pre-existing skips. RuboCop is clean.
